Name: Red Alert
Author: The Button
Description: Run the Red Alert stream from a Stream Deck: lobbies with live tally, player cameras with names, Preview and Take, replays, breaks and toggles that show their real state.

Actions.Name: Lobby
Actions.Tooltip: A lobby into Preview (Take puts it on stream), or cut to stream now. Or the best recent replay into Preview. Shows its number, phase, crew v impostors, the red/green tally and sabotages.

Actions.Name: Player cam
Actions.Tooltip: A player's camera in a lobby: into Preview (Take puts it on), cut to it, or arm it to go on when play resumes. Shows the crewmate, name and who the camera follows.

Actions.Name: Take
Actions.Tooltip: TAKE (submit): what's in Preview goes on stream (Program): lobbies, a player camera, or a replay, which plays. Shows what's in Preview.

Actions.Name: Wide
Actions.Tooltip: Back to the whole map from a player camera.

Actions.Name: Cut to cam
Actions.Tooltip: Cut to a lobby's player camera, keeping who it follows.

Actions.Name: Layout
Actions.Tooltip: Full, 2-up, quad, grid or cameras into Preview (Take puts it on stream). Lit red while on stream, green while in Preview.

Actions.Name: Replay
Actions.Tooltip: Best replay into Preview, play the last clip, replay that, back to live, and the replay transport.

Actions.Name: Toggle
Actions.Tooltip: Mute all, hold, auto grid, auto intermission, auto switch, standings or alerts, showing whether each is on.

Actions.Name: Break
Actions.Tooltip: Be right back, starting soon, intermission, sponsor break, or end the break.

Actions.Name: Panic
Actions.Tooltip: One press: fade to Be right back, mute lobby voice and hold. While that panic is on, the key says UNDO PANIC and a press puts it all back.

Actions.Name: Undo
Actions.Tooltip: Undo: the panic while there is one, else an automatic switch, else the last switch. Lit while a panic is on.

Actions.Name: Custom path
Actions.Tooltip: Any Red Alert Stream Deck link, by its path (for example gfx/skip).

Actions.Name: Preview dial
Actions.Tooltip: Stream Deck +: turn to pick the Preview lobby, push to Take, tap to clear Preview.

Actions.Name: Player dial
Actions.Tooltip: Stream Deck +: turn to pick who a lobby's camera follows, push to cut to it, tap to go back wide.

Actions.Name: Replay dial
Actions.Tooltip: Stream Deck +: turn to scrub the replay (slowly by frames, quickly by seconds), push to play or pause, tap for the speed.
